title: Technologyservice serves Node
description: A technology service serves a node (a workload or compose service) that connects to it and cannot run correctly without it. This is the consumer side, distinct from technology.technologyservice depends-on technology.node, where the service needs the node that hosts it.
x-dr-evidence: A Kubernetes Deployment or docker-compose service whose environment, config or code addresses another Service by name (DATABASE_URL=postgres://db:5432, http://payments-svc); CBM CONNECTS_TO.
